T: One craving. One very long night.
D: Two room-mates set out for late-night sliders and end up on an all-night odyssey across New Jersey.
P: Serve the sliders when Harold and Kumar finally reach the counter.
S: the long drive across New Jersey
Crinkle-cut fries with salt and a side of gravy for dipping, road trip food. Bake 1kg frozen crinkle-cut chips at 220C for 25 minutes.
the strangest stop of the night
Crisp dill pickle spears fried in a light batter with ranch, a weird detour that works.
M: the little square burgers they crave all night
Tiny beef patties steamed on a bed of diced onion, then stacked with cheese and pickles in soft square buns.
W: Thick vanilla milkshakes, the only thing to finish a night like that. Blend 1L vanilla ice cream with 500ml cold milk until thick.
K: Cold cola over ice with a wedge of lime.

s.note: the long drive across New Jersey
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen crinkle-cut chips at 220C for 25 minutes. Make 300ml gravy from powder and serve on the side for dipping. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: the strangest stop of the night
s.how: Pat dry 12 pickle spears, dip in a batter of 120g flour and 150ml cold beer and fry at 180C until golden. Serve with 150ml ranch.

m.note: the little square burgers they crave all night
m.how: Press 600g beef mince thin across a lined tray and cut into 16 squares. Spread 2 finely diced onions in a hot pan with a splash of water, lay the patties on top, cover and steam 3 minutes. Add cheese and serve in 16 small soft buns with pickles.

w.how: Blend 1L vanilla ice cream with 500ml cold milk until thick. Pour into 4 glasses. Serve it at the halfway point of the film. Leave it out for anyone who wants seconds.

d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in cold cola and add a lime wedge. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
